messages: Can we talk about what happened at dinner last night? I've been thinking about it.
It wasn't a small comment. You said it in front of everyone and it humiliated me.
I've been patient about this kind of thing for a long time and I'm starting to run out of patience.
Every single time I try to bring something up you flip it around and make it about you.
No, I won't calm down. I'm allowed to be upset.
You're not even listening. You're just waiting for me to stop talking.
This is exactly what I mean. You dismiss everything I feel.
I don't even know why I bother anymore.
Don't touch me right now, I need space.
I'm going for a walk. Don't wait up.
